content: Huaglishca maquiyuc runamanda
Cutillata israel tandarina huasima Jesus yaicushcai shuc maqui huaglishca runa chibi tiyaura, ñañuyashca ara.
Fariseoguna Jesusta caudsayachingahua nisha samana punzhaibi chi runata alichingachu imashi nisha yuyarisha chapanaura.
Chasna yuyarigllaita Jesus chi maqui huaglishca runata nira, Jatarisha runaguna chaupibi shayari.

Shayaricpi Jesus chibi tiyaucunata tapura, Dios mandashcagunata cadsusha samana punzhaiga imata rana tan. Alita ranaga balinzhu. Mana alita ranahuas balinzhu. Shuc runata huañunamanda quishpichicpihuas balinzhu. Huañuchun nisha saquicpichu balin. Imatata ninguichi canguna. Tapucpi randi paiguna chunlla shayaunaura.

Jesus paigunata ricusha piñarira. Paiguna shungu sinzhi acta yachasha yapa llaquirira paiguna shucta mana llaquinata charishcamanda. Chasna llaquirishami chi runata camba maquita chutai nisha rimara. Pai chutachishcallai ali tucura.
Chi fariseogunaga chimanda llucshisha mandac apu Herodesta caticcunahuan cuintanacunaura imasna Jesusta huanchinamanda.
Ashca ungushcagunata alichishcamanda
Jesus pai yachachishcagunandi chi llacta ucumanda llucshisha Galilea cucha mayanbi rinaura. Pai chima ricpi Galilea llactagunamanda ashca runaguna paita catisha rinaura.

Pai ali raushcagunata ricusha ashca runaguna tucui llactagunamanda shamunaura, Judea llactagunamandas, Jerusalenmandas, Idumea partimandas, Jordan yacu chimba partimandas, Tiro Sidón nishca llactagunamandahuas.
Chasna yapa ashca runaguna shamushcata ricusha Jesus pai yachachishcagunata nira, Shuc canuata alichichi ama runagunahuan tapacta tucungahua.
Pai chasna nira ashca ungushcagunata alichiushcata ricusha, shuc ungushcagunatahuas tangasha tangasha caillayanaura paita llangangahua.
Supai yaicushca runagunaga paita ricusha cungurisha capariunaura, Canga Diospa Churi mangui.
Jesus randi chi supaigunata sinzhita, Ñáuca pi actas ama rimaichichu nira.
Jesus chunga ishcai (12) runata anllashcamanda
Chihuasha Jesus shuc urcuma sicasha tucui paita catiu runagunamanda pai munashca runagunata anllara ñucama shamuichi nisha.
Chunga ishcaillata (12) anllasha ñuca japishca runa nishca tucunguichi ñucahuan pariu tiyangahua, chasnallata Diospa quishpina shimita camachinauchun nisha cachangahua japira.
Chasnallata ushaita paigunama cura supaigunata llucshichisha cachangahua nisha.
Paigunahua shuti caigunami ara: Simon, paita Pedro nishcata shutichira,
Zebedeoba churiguna Santiago, paihua huauqui Juandi, paigunata Rayuhua churiguna nisha shutichira,
Andres, Felipe, Bartolome, Mateo, Tomas, Alfeohua churi Santiago, Tadeo, cananeo muntunmanda Simon,
Chasnallata paita randichic Judas Iscariote.
Jesusta camishcamanda
Chihuasha Jesus shuc huasima pactara. Ashca runaguna chibi tandarimunaupi micungahua lugarta mana charinaurachu.
Paihua ailluguna chita uyasha, paimi nusparishcacuinta tarabaun nisha shamuunaura paita chimanda pushashun nisha.

Moises mandashcagunata yachachiccuna Jerusalenmanda shamusha ninaura, Cai runaga Beelzebú nishca supaigunahua amutami charin, Beelzebú ushaihuanmi supaigunata chasna llucshichin nisha Jesusta caminaura.
Chasna camicpi Jesus cayasha paigunata tapura, Imasna rashata supaiga supaillatataga llucshichinata ushan.
Shuc llactaibi causaccuna chican chican tucucpiga chi llacta chingaringami.
Chasnallata shuc huasibi tiyauc aillupura macanacushaga paiguna tucuringaunami.
Satanaspas pai mandashca supaigunahuan piñanacushaga mana unayasha tucuringami.
Mana pihuas shuc sinzhi runahua huasima shuhuangahua yaicunata ushanzhu paita ñaupata mana huatasha churashaga. Paita huatasha churashcahuashallami shuhuanata ushanga nira.
Cangunata nini, Tucui tunu juchata rashcagunata, tucui jiridsa shimigunatahuas Dioslla anchuchinata ushan.
Randi shuc runa Diospa Samaita camishaga mana ima uraspas perdunaitucungachu, chasna camishcamanda huiñai juchayuc tucungami nira.
Jesus chasna yachachira paiguna supaita pai charinmi nisha rimashcamanda.
Jesuspa mamamanda
Jesus rimaushcai paihua mama, paihua huauquigunandi pactamusha canzhai shayarisha shuc runata cachanaura rimangahua.
Jesuspa mayanbi liyú tiyaucuna paita rimanaura, Uyai, camba mama camba huauquigunandi canzhaibi tiyaunguna, canda mascaunguna.
Randi Jesus paigunata nira, Pitan ñuca mama, pigunatanaun ñuca huauquiguna.
Casna nisha paita liyú tiyaucunata ricusha nira, Caiguna man ñuca mama tucuc, ñuca huauquiguna tucuc.
Maicanbas Dios munashcata pactachic runami ñuca huauqui, ñuca pani, ñuca mama anaun nira.
